name: TrickBot
description: TrickBot (operated by Wizard Spider) is a Russian cybercrime group of approximately 80 members based in St. Petersburg, Russia. They developed the TrickBot banking trojan and botnet, then pivoted to deploying Ryuk and Conti ransomware against large organizations. The group also deployed Emotet as a delivery mechanism. UK and US governments sanctioned seven core members in 2022.

sources.title: U.S., U.K. Sanction 7 Men Tied to Trickbot Hacking Group — Krebs on Security
